world_news_real.title: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
world_news_real.description: A new 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian imports comes into force after a last-minute breakdown in trade talks.

world_news_real.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
world_news_real.description: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

world_news_real.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
world_news_real.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

world_news_real.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' strike
world_news_real.description: Nine people are still missing after the attack which left 130 injured, including a number of children.

world_news_real.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
world_news_real.description: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

world_news_real.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike, reports say
world_news_real.description: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

world_news_real.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
world_news_real.description: The defence brought their final witness - a forensic psychiatrist - to the stand to testify about the effects of postpartum psychosis.

world_news_real.title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
world_news_real.description: Seven World Central Kitchen workers were killed in the Israeli strike on their convoy in 2024.

world_news_real.title: Sydney Marathon medal mistakenly depicts Munich stadium
world_news_real.description: Online sleuths detected the error after Sydney Marathon unveiled the double-sided medal.

world_news_real.title: Two injured in stabbing attack at Canada Sikh temple
world_news_real.description: One suspect is in custody, and police have said they are still investigating if the attack was motivated by hate.
